§6Unsaturated Hydrocarbons§f

§aGaseous feedstock from cracked oil  -  rubber, PVC, perfluoromethyl, and C-4 all start with this!§f

Refining §bHot Cracked Oil§f in the §bOil Refinery§f produces Unsaturated Hydrocarbons as a gas alongside Aromatic Hydrocarbons. You get §e150mB§f per §e1,000mB§f of cracked oil. It provides §e3.66 MTU§f per bucket as a gaseous fuel.

§6Sources§f:
§b•§f Oil Refinery from cracked oil variants.
§b•§f Catalytic Cracking Tower from Reformate.
§b•§f Catalytic Reformer from Petroleum Gas.

§6Recipes§f:
§b•§f Rubber: §e500mB§f + Sulfur in Chemical Plant.
§b•§f PVC: §e250mB§f + §e250mB§f Chlorine Gas + Cadmium Powder yields 2x PVC.
§b•§f Perfluoromethyl: §e500mB§f + §e1,000mB§f Petroleum Gas + Fluorite.
§b•§f C-4: §e500mB§f + Niter.
§b•§f Engine Lubricant: §e500mB§f + §e500mB§f Heating Oil.
§b•§f Phosgene: §e500mB§f + §e500mB§f Chlorine Gas.

§ePS:§f This is the gateway to rubber and PVC. Keep a steady flow from your cracked oil line!
